ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level ratio of approximately 65% high-intensity (white/light-grey) to 35% low-intensity (dark-grey/black) pixels across the visible ventral lobe segment.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A primary contiguous light-intensity geometric zone is centered in the visible lobe, bounded by a dark-intensity jagged border at the proximal edge and a concentrated dark-intensity cluster at the distal apex.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: A linear, slightly concave pixel trajectory observed along the leading edge boundary extending to the distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of a localized, irregular, high-contrast dark pixel cluster at the distal tip of the fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent dark, textured growth or encrustation localized at the extreme distal tip of the visible lobe.
